items.title: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap at Unite Seoul
items.excerpt: Unity revealed its Unity 7 roadmap at Unite Seoul: same Unity 6 architecture with zero-rebuild upgrades, AI-assisted graphics optimization and integration with the Unity Vector AI engine. Unity says the release is 'built for a future where humans and coding agents can work together,' while promising studios that keep AI out of creative work aren't sidelined.

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 hands full control to artists to direct the final frame
items.excerpt: NVIDIA detailed the developer controls in DLSS 5, giving artists tools and sliders to direct the final AI-upscaled frame and retain 'artistic integrity.' It responds directly to fears that neural rendering strips creative control over how a game ultimately looks.

items.title: Meshy wants AI to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
items.excerpt: Meshy launched a 3D Agent Beta, a conversational AI that keeps context across steps so game artists can brainstorm, generate stylistically consistent asset collections and iterate — positioning AI as a creative partner rather than a one-shot prompt. Assets export to Blender, Unreal Engine and Unity pipelines.

items.title: NVIDIA reveals the controls devs actually have for DLSS 5's AI filter
items.excerpt: PC Gamer breaks down the two main sliders NVIDIA is giving developers to steer the DLSS 5 AI filter, after concerns that the neural renderer removes artistic control over the final image. More dev-facing controls are reportedly being built.

items.title: Half of all Steam games will use AI by 2028, study predicts
items.excerpt: The same large Steam study predicts AI-disclosed games will cross ~50% of all releases by 2027–2028, noting AI 'lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several.' A data-driven look at how fast AI game creation is scaling.
